description: Binary assertions for /forge-pulse Last30Days-to-IPARAG ingestion skill

assertions.name: raw_file_location
assertions.check: skill reads raw files from the Last30Days memory dir, handles comparison multi-file runs

assertions.name: inbox_capture
assertions.check: creates a 0_Inbox capture note with mandatory why-context and PARA frontmatter

assertions.name: galaxy_propose_only
assertions.check: Galaxy candidates are propose-only, never auto-created
assertions.regex: PROPOSE ONLY|propose.?only|KHÔNG tự tạo|chờ CEO duyệt

assertions.name: atomic_principle
assertions.check: one concept per Galaxy candidate, evergreen test excludes news-only items
assertions.regex: atomic|1 khái niệm|>1 khái niệm|sống lâu

assertions.name: wikilink_minimum
assertions.check: each candidate proposes at least 2 wikilinks

assertions.name: harvest_routing
assertions.check: routes insights to forge-market-intel and/or mentor-board with COD labels

assertions.name: notebooklm_push
assertions.check: optional NotebookLM push via notebooklm-mcp source_add

assertions.name: citation_integrity
assertions.check: claims keep briefing citations, none fabricated

assertions.name: correct_vault_path
assertions.check: uses D:\Workshop_X vault path, not stale E:\ paths
